neha_support: Hey @jun_eng — customer (Acme Inc) reports 403 when switching org->project in the console after an org rename. They use an API key for their deployment. Error shown in UI: `permission denied`.

jun_eng: Are they using API keys or OIDC tokens for the console call? Can you paste a short repro and the x-request-id?

neha_support: They're using a long-lived API key bound to the project. Minimal repro (redacted key):
```bash
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_REDACTED' \n  -d 'project=proj-acme-202' \n  https://console.redwood.com/v1/projects/switch
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```json
{
  "error": {"code":"access_denied","message":"not authorized for project: proj-acme-202"},
  "x-request-id":"req_abc123"
}
```

jun_eng: thx. Can you grab the API key metadata from the admin UI (/admin/keys) or from the support panel? Also paste the x-request-id if you have server logs.

neha_support: From admin metadata (redacted):
- key_id: sk_live_REDACTED
- project_alias: acme-prod
- project_id: proj-acme-101  <-- old project id
- last_synced_ts: 2026-03-15T01:58:12Z
Org rename happened yesterday (acme-inc -> acme-corp) at 2026-03-15T02:12:03Z. The alias->id mapping was updated to proj-acme-202 but the key meta still points at proj-acme-101. Resync job shows a few 409s for that org.

olivia_prod: That explains it. The token-exchange path first validates the key.project_id against the requested project id. If the key metadata contains a stale id, we reject instead of re-resolving the alias. Looks like alias mapping changed during org rename and key metadata didn't get updated due to a resync conflict.

sam_idp: We also saw SCIM/group rename rules running during the rename. Our group-normalizer rule strips non-alphanum and lowercases claims which trimmed a suffix on a few aliases. That may have changed how aliases matched during the batch resync.

jun_eng: Short-term mitigation: rebind the key metadata to the correct project id or create a new API key for the customer. Longer term: we should make token-exchange fall back to alias->id resolution if meta mismatch occurs and surface a clear diagnostic.

neha_support: Customer accepted the temporary workaround (new key deployed) — access restored. They asked for a permanent fix so keys don't silently break after org/alias changes.

olivia_prod: I created internal ticket INC-21045 and scheduled an alias-sync run for the affected org. Proposed fixes:
- token-exchange: if key.project_id != requested project id, try alias lookup before rejecting (safe fallback + audit log)
- add /admin/keys/validate endpoint to show alias vs resolved id vs last_synced_ts for troubleshooting
- make resync job retry on 409s with exponential backoff and a small jitter so rename races don't leave stale metadata

support-bot: Ticket INC-21045 created and linked to customer case CS-9987. Assigned: jun_eng, olivia_prod. ETA: 48h. :white_check_mark:

neha_support: Great — I'll update the customer and patch the support ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
